name: NeurIPS 2024 proceedings index, full-text title sweep
notes: Same URL as sco-neurips-2024-proceedings but recorded separately because this record documents a FULL-TEXT sweep of all 4493 NeurIPS 2024 entries (Main Conference Track + Datasets and Benchmarks Track) performed on 2026-10-04, not a single-paper lookup. Positive matches by exact title: SpecExec (hash 1d91d5689e251d27993a3c2182dddcf7, authors Svirschevski, May, Chen, Chen, Jia, Ryabinin - matching arXiv 2406.02532), Cascade Speculative Drafting (hash 9cb5b083ba4f5ca6bd05dd307a2fb354), MiniCache (hash fd0705710bf01b88a60a3d479ea341d9, authors Akide Liu et al. matching arXiv 2405.14366). NEGATIVE for S-LoRA: a case-insensitive sweep of the entire index for 'LoRA' returns only LoRA fine-tuning and training-method papers (HydraLoRA, VB-LoRA, FLoRA, Safe LoRA, LoRANN, etc.) and no S-LoRA entry - so S-LoRA's arXiv comment is not claiming NeurIPS 2024 for anything present here. Kept as a distinct id so a reader can tell a per-paper confirmation from a corpus-wide negative.
